title: The Social Engineer Who Stole a Country’s Election Map—by Pretending to Clean Carpets
hook: He walked into a secure government building with a vacuum cleaner, and walked out with classified voting data.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic confidence trick with high stakes—shows how trust is the weakest link in security.

title: The Dark Persuasion Science That Made a Man Donate His Entire Fortune—to a Scammer
hook: A scammer used a single psychological lever to make a billionaire give away his bank account access in 11 minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Money and vulnerability—people want to know how they could be tricked too.

title: The Manipulation Tactic That Made a Student Steal His Best Friend’s Identity—for a Grade
hook: A subtle peer-pressure technique pushed a top student to swap lives with a rival, destroying both futures in weeks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable academic setting twisted into dark crime—high relatability and betrayal shock.

title: The Social Engineer Who Stole a Museum’s Most Valuable Painting—by Complaining About the Air Conditioning
hook: He distracted an entire security team by pretending to be cold, then walked out with a masterpiece under his coat.
why_this_can_go_viral: Clever and audacious—audiences love trickster stories with low-tech methods.

title: The Manipulation Tactic That Made a Doctor Prescribe Poison—to Healthy Patients
hook: A simple reward system tricked a medical professional into harming 30 people, believing it was life-saving medicine.
why_this_can_go_viral: Medical ethics nightmare—trusted profession corrupted by subtle incentives.

title: The Psychological Warfare That Made a Village Starve Itself—for a Ritual
hook: A visiting strategist used fear of 'impurity' to convince a community to abandon food storage, leading to mass hunger.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploitation of cultural beliefs—shows how psychological attacks can be deadlier than weapons.

title: The Cognitive Bias That Made a Banker Give Away the Vault Code—After a Compliment
hook: A single piece of flattery about his tie made a bank manager reveal the combination to a vault containing millions.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyday social behavior weaponized—viewers recognize their own vulnerability to flattery.
